name: FM.video
author: Tim Thomas
description: Radio with music videos on your desktop. See what a station is playing in the bar, pick from over 200 stations, and watch the music videos in a small window that stays on top on every workspace. Shows the lyric line in the bar, in time with the song, when the song has timed lyrics.

barWidget.description: The song on now, with play, pause and next. Click for stations, the video window and lyrics.
